title: 查询自适应语义分块：面向检索增强生成的动态上下文窗口扩展策略
summary: 提出查询自适应语义分块（QASC），通过将用户查询集成到分块阶段，利用余弦相似度评分、上下文窗口扩展和分块级分数聚合动态构建块。在100篇技术文档、200个查询上评估，F1分数达0.85，相比固定分块提升18-27%，相比语义和代理方法提升8-12%。
summary_en: Proposes Query-Adaptive Semantic Chunking (QASC) that integrates user queries into chunking via cosine similarity scoring, contextual window expansion, and chunk-level score aggregation. Evaluated on 100 technical documents with 200 queries, achieving F1-score of 0.85, improving 18-27% over fixed chunking and 8-12% over semantic/agentic methods.
